scripts.dev: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && concurrently --raw --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @applyflow/contracts" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:generate && npm run dev -w @applyflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run db:generate && vitest run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run db:generate && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:watch: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run db:generate && vitest
scripts.bench:passwords: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run bench:passwords -w @applyflow/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run build -w @applyflow/api && npm run build -w @applyflow/web
